findings.evidence: `nl -ba` shows the theorem at lines 138-142 states `Prod.map ... x = (...)`; the preceding `relativeProdHom_apply` at lines 129-133 is the actual bridge to the subgroup homomorphism.
findings.fix: Change the statement to `(relativeProdHom (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) s t p : (M × N) ≃ₘ^n⟮I.prod J, I.prod J⟯ M × N) x = ((p.1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x.1, (p.2 : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) x.2)`.
findings.issue: `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` is not a pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`; its left side is `Prod.map ... x`, so the theorem is unrelated to applying the relative homomorphism and will not rewrite `(relativeProdHom s t p) x`.

summary: The relative product pointwise API is mis-formalized: the theorem advertised as the pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom` never mentions `relativeProdHom`, so it proves only the definitional behavior of `Prod.map`.
